entries.name: Vehicle traffic signal
entries.description: Three-aspect vehicle signal head controlling right of way at a junction or crossing.

entries.name: Red signal state
entries.description: Signal showing red: vehicles must stop at the stop line.

entries.name: Amber signal state
entries.description: Signal showing amber: change interval preceding red.

entries.name: Green signal state
entries.description: Signal showing green: proceed when safe.

entries.name: Directional arrow signal
entries.description: Signal aspect with an arrow permitting or controlling a specific movement.

entries.name: Pedestrian signal
entries.description: Signal head for pedestrians showing walk and don't-walk figures.

entries.name: Flashing signal
entries.description: Flashing amber (caution) or flashing red aspect, often used at night or on signal failure.

entries.name: Lane-control signal
entries.description: Overhead lane signal indicating an open lane (arrow) or closed lane (cross).

entries.name: Railway crossing signal
entries.description: Alternately flashing red lights warning of an approaching train at a level crossing.

entries.name: Police hand signals
entries.description: Traffic police directing traffic by hand; directions override signals and signs.

references.note: Driver obligation to follow police directions; clause pending verification.

entries.name: Variable message sign
entries.description: Electronic sign displaying changeable text or pictograms for incidents and conditions.

entries.name: Toll and access-control signal
entries.description: Toll plaza lane signal and boom barrier controlling access.
